name: Mirror Shore of Half-Remembered Places
description: A coastal shore is lined with smooth black mirrors, each reflecting a different impossible memory.
prompt: A surreal shoreline where smooth black mirrors rise from the wet sand, each mirror reflects a different impossible memory: a treehouse, a field of lilies, a red bicycle, a stormy port, sunset light, reflective water, emotional, photorealistic surreal, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: Some places only exist when we remember them. Which mirror would you step into?
